_comment: Shape of runs/<run>/trials/<trial>/summary.json written by the harness (design R44). Null means uncollected or unknown; the harness never substitutes guessed counts. Manifest-level identifiers (OpenAI project, model IDs, SDK/harness hashes, pricing snapshot, prompt/schema hashes) live in runs/<run>/manifest.json; per-attempt fields (attempt_id, client/server request ids, response id, payload hash and path, raw usage, derived counters, reserve/cost, telemetry status, failure reason) live in requests.jsonl.
